_comment: FORMAT REFERENCE ONLY. Every value here is invented to show the shape; nothing describes a real initiative. Delete this key when producing a real file. Stage: not-started | in-progress | in-approvals | kickoff-set | launched. Engagement: not-contacted | declined | contacted | interested | committed. Stakeholder types must be keys from stakeholder-types.json. potentialSolutions is a list of short strings, one per proposed deliverable. Dates: dateLogged is YYYY-MM-DD; update 'at' is ISO 8601. The id becomes the page address; letters, digits and hyphens only.
